leg: Event banner upgrade: sticky, under nav, dismissible until local midnight, less mobile sky, event-first copy (operator mobile-screenshot directive, ledger row 124)
operator_directive_verbatim: Banner should be sticky / Banner should be under nav / Banner should be dismissible (but not cookies, or short lived so it returns next day) / Shouldn't have so much empty room, not so much sky on Mobile / Banner text more like "Next event: City council meeting, {{when & where}}. Show up by wearing green! {{Glyph/minor text for more}}"
sticky_implementation: the same one banner element (upgraded in place, never a second banner): position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 60 on .alert-strip, in DOM order directly below the nav (the shell now renders {nav} then {alert}; the 2026-11-24 build had the strip above the masthead). Sticky keeps its layout space, so nothing overlaps at load; while scrolled it rides the viewport top and content passes beneath an opaque surface. Measured: stuckTop 0 at 412/768/1440/1920.
return_rule: DISMISSED UNTIL LOCAL MIDNIGHT (named and implemented): the close click stores new Date().toDateString() under the single localStorage key psp-event-banner-day; the load hides the banner only while the stored day equals today, so tomorrow's date mismatch returns the banner. No cookies, no consent machinery. Behavioral proof at 412: click dismisses (stored 'Wed Nov 25 2026'), reload same day still hidden, storing yesterday's day ('Tue Nov 24 2026') and reloading returns the banner (captured). Storage refused (private mode): the catch dismisses for the visit only and stores nothing.
noscript: the served markup carries no hidden attribute on the banner, so it shows without scripting; the close button ships with the hidden attribute and is revealed by script only, so the no-JS page loses nothing (the meeting facts are in the banner text itself).
copy_as_shipped: Next event: City Council meeting, Tuesday, Dec. 1 at 6:30 p.m., City Hall Council Chambers, 25 Cottage Road. Show up by wearing green! + a small underlined Details link to act-now.html as the glyph affordance. NAMED DIVERGENCE: the operator's comma form of the venue vs the featured block's 'in City Hall Council Chambers' (facts identical); 'Show up by wearing green!' vs the block's 'Wear green and come to the City Council meeting' (same fact, operator's wording is the instruction); the two sentences keep the past-event-invitation split (date sentence carries no invitation verb). The Details link is a link, not a transmitting control, so the UAT payload story is unchanged.
mobile_sky: phone-only counterpart to the desktop cap: at max-width 700px the hero's top padding drops 495px to 300px, so the card arrives 195px sooner and the sky above the lighthouse shrinks with the band. Measured before/after at 412: region 1229 to 1034, card top 495 to 300. Desktop and tablet rules untouched: 1440 and 1920 re-measured at region 788.9/789.6 and card top 170 (the 41.125vw cap binding exactly as the composition leg sized it), 768 at 865.4/360 - all byte-for-byte the shipped geometry.
contrast: the sticky surface is opaque var(--orange-dark) rgb(184, 64, 26) with white text: measured 5.55:1 from the served banner pixels (AA passes for the 0.92rem text). Because the surface is opaque (no alpha), the contrast over whatever scrolls beneath is this same measured pair, not a composite.

round1_review_finding_and_fix: the full-class review (round 1) failed one finding: the dismissed banner kept rendering because the author-origin display:flex on .alert-strip overrides the browser's built-in [hidden] rule, and only the close button had a guard. Fixed with .alert-strip[hidden] { display: none; }. The manifest's original 'banner dismissed-412: banner gone' claim was WRONG at head 1d8dede - the capture was committed unread and in fact showed the banner still on screen; the round-2 captures re-taken after the fix are read and this time the dismissed state is verified visually AND by computed style (display none, height 0).
